tactics.tasks.title: Tasks
tactics.tasks.addHint: Give the selected units a task (I); Shift and a digit for the nine at hand
tactics.tasks.search: Search tasks by name or letters
tactics.tasks.selectFirst: Select the units first; control measures need none.
tactics.tasks.needsUnit: That task needs a unit: select one first.
tactics.tasks.conflictMark: Something cannot work: see the list under Tasks
tactics.tasks.label: Name
tactics.tasks.points: {n, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} on the map
tactics.tasks.none: No tasks yet: select units and press I.
tactics.tasks.conflicts: {n, plural, one {# thing cannot work} other {# things cannot work}}
tactics.taskHint.attack: Close with the enemy at a point; an arrow from the unit to it.
tactics.taskHint.seize: Take an objective: an arrow into a circle on it.
tactics.taskHint.secure: Hold an area clear of the enemy: its outline.
tactics.taskHint.breach: Break through an obstacle: a line with bars at both ends.
tactics.taskHint.sweep: Search an area: lanes, an expanding square or a sector search at the unit's speed.
tactics.taskHint.ambush: Attack from concealment into a kill zone: its outline and the ambush line.
tactics.taskHint.defend: Hold a battle position facing a sector.
tactics.taskHint.block: Deny the enemy a way: a line with a bar at its end.
tactics.taskHint.delay: Trade ground for time along a line.
tactics.taskHint.withdraw: Break contact and move back to a point.
tactics.taskHint.patrol: Go round a route, as a loop or there and back, for a while or a number of times, with a wait at the start.
tactics.taskHint.screen: Watch a flank and warn: a sector.
tactics.taskHint.guard: Protect a unit or a place, and fight for it: a sector.
tactics.taskHint.recon: Watch a sector; without a bearing it follows the sensor keyframes.
tactics.taskHint.escort: Move beside and behind another unit to protect it.
tactics.taskHint.overwatch: Cover others from a position into a sector.
tactics.taskHint.suppress: Fire into a sector or at a point to keep the enemy down.
tactics.taskHint.smoke: A smoke screen along a line or at a point.
tactics.taskHint.orbit: Fly a circle or a racetrack at a set height and speed.
tactics.taskHint.cas: Attack ground targets in an area near friendly troops.
tactics.taskHint.sead: Suppress or destroy air defences in an area.
tactics.taskHint.intercept: Fly to another aircraft and stay with it.
tactics.taskHint.hold: Wait at a waypoint until a time, a go-code, another unit reaching a waypoint, or another task starting or ending.
tactics.taskHint.phaseLine: A named line for timing and control.
tactics.taskHint.roe: Rules of engagement: weapons free, tight, return fire or hold.
tactics.taskHint.alarm: Alarm state or behaviour: green, red, safe, aware, combat, stealth.
tactics.taskHint.game: A task from a mission file the board has no task for, kept by its own name.
tactics.conflict.moves: {figure}: {task} and {other} both move it at the same time.
tactics.conflict.excludes: {figure}: {task} and {other} cannot run at the same time.
tactics.conflict.domain: {figure}: {task} is not a task for this kind of unit.
tactics.conflict.fit: {figure}: {task} needs {needs} even at top speed and has {given}.
tactics.conflict.speed: {figure}: {task} asks for {needs} m/s; its top speed is {given} m/s, so it goes at that.
tactics.conflict.trigger: {figure}: the trigger of {task} never comes ({reason, select, code {the go-code has no time} cycle {it waits for itself} after {it comes after the plan ends} other {nothing is set to wait for}}).
tactics.conflict.routeMoves: {figure}: {task} moves it while its route also does; the task wins meanwhile.
tactics.conflict.realTime: {figure}: {task} at a waypoint plays only with real-time steps.
tactics.conflict.noRoute: {figure}: {task} is on a route it does not have in that step.
tactics.conflict.geometry: {task} needs {needs, plural, one {a point} other {# points}} on the map; draw them.
